title: Enterprise Support: Cash-return limit for retained-fee cash return
content:
Enterprise Support — Cash-return limit for retained-fee cash return.

## Decision basis

For retained-fee cash return: The proposed amount refund is the smaller of the surplus after retained funding and the remaining original payment principal floored at zero. The selected refund request cannot exceed either the surplus after retained funding or the nonnegative remaining original payment principal.

## Hypothetical case

For retained-fee cash return: Suppose surplus after retained funding is hypothetically USD 210 and nonnegative remaining original principal is USD 150. The proposed amount refund is USD 150. If those hypothetical limits are reversed, the proposed amount is still USD 150.
